defects: Predicate type mismatch: gold uses p : α → Bool as required by List.find?/List.countP; produced declares p : α → Prop with [DecidablePred p], which does not directly typecheck as the Bool-valued argument these core list functions expect (would need an explicit `decide`/Bool-valued wrapper).

Hypothesis strength mismatch: gold's hypothesis {x ∈ l₁ | p x}.Subsingleton only requires at most one DISTINCT VALUE in l₁ satisfying p (duplicates of that value are fine), whereas produced's l.countP p ≤ 1 requires at most one OCCURRENCE/position satisfying p. countP ≤ 1 implies Subsingleton but not conversely (e.g. l₁ = [1,2,1] with p x := x=1 has countP = 2 but the filtered set {1} is still subsingleton), so produced's hypothesis is strictly stronger than gold's, making produced a weaker/less general theorem.
